defects.invariant: A decrement cannot leave an item with a negative or zero quantity.
defects.observation: The second decrement leaves a zero-quantity Rift Hoodie item in the cart.

defects.invariant: A discount is subtracted exactly once from the displayed total.
defects.observation: A 100-cent discount produces a displayed total of 800 cents from a 1,000-cent subtotal.

defects.invariant: A coupon with an expiry before the checkout time is rejected.
defects.observation: The expired WELCOME10 coupon is accepted at the fixed reproduction time.

defects.invariant: Product search matches names without regard to query casing.
defects.observation: Searching for lowercase hoodie returns no products even though Rift Hoodie exists.
